newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE AND ENGLAND DRAW TEST AND SERIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE AND ENGLAND DRAW TEST AND SERIES.

text.p: England's historic first test series against Zimbabwe ended in frustration on Monday after the second and final test was abandoned as a draw without a ball being bowled on the final day because of a rain soaked outfield.
England were 195 for three in their second innings, a lead of 136.

An unbroken stand of 106 for the fourth wicket between Alec Stewart (101 not out) and Graham Thorpe (50 not out) on Sunday had hauled England back into the match after Zimbabwe had taken a 59-run first innings lead.
The second test failed to produce the drama of the first in Bulawayo, which ended in a draw with the scores tied.
The teams now play two more one-day matches on the same ground before England fly to New Zealand for a three-test series.
Zimbabwe are 1-0 up in the one-day series which resumes on New Year's Day with the final match on January 3.
